findings.recommendation: GET original /api/dispatch-notices with recipient; bind exact OFFER event_id/preparation_id/dispatch_id/revision; OPEN then MARK_READ and monotonic timestamps. After Case cancellation GET/OPEN original authorized notice and assert case_cancelled=true/actionable=false, no offer state WITHDRAWN fabrication and late ACCEPT409. Include outbox/notices/projection counts or scoped PG oracle.

findings.detail: T07-G promises no receipt/ACK no close; actual new full-chain test closes only after complete acknowledged business records.
findings.recommendation: On same chain after ACCEPT and again after SUBMIT-before-ACK, submit original local REVALIDATE/CLOSE with current CAS/SHA and expect409/no local event/business mutation. Preserve need for P4 verification. After CLOSE assert Case WAITING_CONFIRMATION, old P5 NEEDS_RECHECK before fresh explicit VERIFY; after REOPEN assert cleared verification/current cycle2 and no current result until explicit REVALIDATE/P5VERIFY.

findings.detail: setup.actor='executor-a' misidentifies the assignment target as the setup authority; actual invoker is owner Store.
findings.recommendation: Use setup_actor=OWNED_SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_DATABASE_OWNER and target_executor_id=executor-a. Assert exactly one intended new assignment with exact Run/scope/active/managed_access=None and all earlier assignment rows unchanged, plus current existing role/READ. Keep all other authority tables byte/logically unchanged.

findings.detail: actual_http starts a new API object/thread in the same host process; current cold check reads only goal-results.
findings.recommendation: Label API-object/Store replacement accurately. For process-cold claim start ordinary uvicorn configured_app factory in own child with same low-privilege DSN and no bridges, preserve PID/argv/exit/stdout/stderr and GET original Run/material/receipt/plan/recovery/local/goals. Do not run existing Chromium helper. At minimum read exact same IDs/version/SHA after fresh Store and assert no business writes.
